items.name: Automation
items.title: Processes that move on their own
items.body: I connect the tools you already use —email, invoicing, spreadsheets, CRM— so each step triggers the next without anyone having to remember.

items.name: Applied AI
items.title: AI that reads, understands and records
items.body: It reads invoices, emails and documents, picks out what matters and logs it where it belongs. Inside your own tools, not in a separate window.

items.name: Custom software
items.title: Websites and internal systems
items.body: Dashboards, portals and applications built around the way you work, for when no off-the-shelf tool fits.

items.name: Mobile apps
items.title: Apps for iOS and Android
items.body: For your team on the road or for your customers: instant notifications, sign-in with their own account, published on the App Store and Google Play.
